description: Employee with wages under the Social Security wage base.
worked:
One employee, one employer, wages 120,000 in 2025.
Social Security (OASDI) employee tax: 2025 wage base 176,100; wages subject = smaller of 120,000 and 176,100 = 120,000; 6.2% x 120,000 = 7,440.
Medicare (hospital insurance) employee tax: no wage base; 1.45% x 120,000 = 1,740 (the 0.9% additional Medicare tax is figured on Form 8959 with the return, not here).
